lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: {name}! Ikaw ang na-nominate na Finance / Logistics Officer ng org! Malaking tulong 'to sa leadership resume mo at may libreng snacks tuwing event!
lines.textEn: {name}! You got nominated as Org Finance & Logistics Officer! Huge resume boost plus free event meals!

choices.text: Active member na lang muna — kailangan ko bantayan ang GWA.
choices.textEn: Stay an active member — need to guard my GWA first.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Tagumpay ang org fundraising fair natin! Nag-iwan ang sponsor ng honorarium para sa organizing committee — ₱350 share mo!
lines.textEn: Our org fundraiser crushed its goal! The sponsor gave an honorarium to the committee — ₱350 is your share!

choices.text: Tanggapin ang honorarium at i-log sa budget! (+₱350, +Social)
choices.textEn: Claim the honorarium and celebrate with the team! (+₱350, +Social)
